verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Agents SDK and Think harness explicitly list MCP as a first-class built-in capability for Workers-based agents ('built-in support for ... MCP', 'MCP tools' as a tool type), and the payments docs describe agents making MCP tool calls, confirming Workers agents can consume external MCP servers as tool sources, not just serve them. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a developer actually wiring a third-party MCP server into a Workers agent and successfully invoking its tools, and clearer step-by-step client-side connection docs (most agent-setup docs emphasize Cloudflare's own MCP servers rather than generic third-party ones).
